title: [spec-gap][R-07-028] Duty-cycle MUST: single accounting group only, no per-frequency occupancy tracking (all stacks)
description: spec/07-transport-app.md:527: 'Nodes MUST track duty cycle usage by the applicable regulatory accounting group and, where dwell limits apply, occupancy per physical frequency.' All 3 stacks implement exactly ONE rolling 1-hour window per node with regional profiles: rust/lichen-core/src/duty_cycle.rs:348 DutyCycleTracker (single TxRecord ring, WINDOW_MS=3.6e6, EU868 1%/US915 dwell 400ms profiles :78-122), python/src/lichen/timing/duty_cycle.py:142 RegionalDutyCycleEnforcer, C lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_duty.c + duty_cycle.h:15-19 (TX gate lora_l2_tx.c:500-509, record :627-628). No per-accounting-group multiplexing; dwell is a per-TX ceiling, not per-frequency occupancy accounting. The tracking kernel itself is implemented+tested (duty_cycle_calculation.json, Semtech airtime oracle; rust duty_cycle_vectors.rs:70,111; py tests/timing/test_duty_cycle_vectors.py; C lichen/tests/regional_duty_cycle) - the divergence is scope, not arithmetic. Suggested placement: decide multi-group/per-frequency requirement (EU sub-band hopping needs per-sub-band budgets) then extend DutyCycleTracker key or amend spec to single-group scope; C wiring point lora_l2_tx.c, rust duty_cycle.rs, py timing/duty_cycle.py.
